about: Every record that changed when New Jersey's 2023 and 2025 legislatures were read from the Division of Elections' Official Lists (the orchestrator, 2026-11-07 10:35: 'queue the odd-year legislatures after Klarner's 2022 (MS, NJ, VA 2023; NJ, VA 2025) from each state's certified files, each with a gate you propose. Reason: law 5 and Zach's 03:13 word, as much data as can be found.'), and 2023 fed into the later years (11:56: 'earlier cycles only means every earlier contest'). Against b9e0702 (main after #91, whose data files are those of #90, 6119f98). pipeline/intake/nj_sos.py, pipeline/local_nj_leg.py, pipeline/local_medsl.py. Codes: 'A' a new record (New Jersey's 121: the 2023 Senate's 40 and Assembly's 40, the 2025 Assembly's 40 and its Senate's Thirty-Fifth, special); 'P' p moved, with its ratio after/before: New Jersey's 2023 Senate (38 Democrat-against-Republican races) now in route (a)'s fit for 2024, which moves 2024's partisan legislative p and the transferred local route's, and New Jersey's 2023 contests now among 2024's like races, which moves 2024's legislative class and boundary p; ratios local [0.9986, 0.9994, 1.0022], state-lower [0.9943, 0.9999, 1.0699], state-upper [0.9943, 0.9998, 1.0425] (min, median, max); 'B' p unchanged, its block changed (a t4 value beside it); 'O' other fields: a forecast's note, which now names every source the fit and like races take in (Klarner's, and Louisiana's and New Jersey's 2023), or a forecast's sd in its fourth digit. No p became computed or was lost outside New Jersey. The tests' verdicts are unchanged: the 2024 back-test of the transferred local route holds 51.9% in its 50% interval (as before; the rule is 40%-60%), 81.1% in its 80% (81.0%); the calibration of 2024 reads expected_after 54.6 (54.7), deviance_by_office_type_before 17.57 (17.58), deviance_after 16.85 (16.86), and 'improves' and 'adopted' are as before. Records whose p block changed in its commit stamp alone (104) are not listed. data/local/REPORT.md section 27. Written by worker D3 at 2026-11-07 18:10 UTC.

codes.G: a record no longer written (joined into another, or replaced)
codes.R: not computed before or after, the reason changed
